summary_reuse_proposal.possible_scope_now: Human research summary at the observed page-group level, explicitly retaining purchase-SKU uncertainty and purposive-sample limits.
summary_reuse_proposal.reuse_unit: A source-linked evidence item and its scope/uncertainty, rather than a detached summary sentence. The same item can be linked by product UX, service onboarding, installation, or positioning hypotheses without copying it into another split.

human_read_examples.observation: The reviewer reports slow heating, attempted service/part replacement and a refund, and dissatisfaction with power-setting guidance.
human_read_examples.hypothesis_only: Investigate heating reproducibility and how power settings and service guidance are explained. This is not verified defect evidence or an exact-SKU product requirement.

human_read_examples.observation: The reviewer reports missing installation handoff for hardness testing, rinse aid and salt initialization.
human_read_examples.hypothesis_only: Reuse the same evidence in installation-service onboarding/checklist research, with ownership and actual setup requirements verified separately.

human_read_examples.observation: The reviewer says the front access area makes frequently retrieving drinks convenient.
human_read_examples.hypothesis_only: Preserve this reported strength while considering frequent-use item access UX. No quantified preference or verified purchased-SKU claim.

additional_category_feasibility.inference: If the official title contains 냉장고, the current fridge title keyword could superficially match. That does not establish correct category, storage function scope, manual version, or review purchased SKU; a separately verified registry and manual scope are required.

Current title/group mapping has no induction entry. A normal public review UI may share the row structure, but no new product page/MD or collection success was verified. The observed induction-related text on a dishwasher page is a concrete warning against page-level SKU attribution.

The existing microwave URL category is microwaves-and-ovens, but the title check requires 전자레인지. An oven title cannot be assumed to pass. Oven-specific functions, manual and exact page identity need explicit scope verification.

No current group/title mapping, purchased-model mapping, care-service versus product-review separation or independent source sample was verified. Treat as a later bounded research candidate, not a supported input today.

implementation_conclusion: Existing source-linked research evidence can support review-summary/UI planning and other planning hypotheses. Additional source adapters, schemas or model generation were neither edited nor executed in this review.
